title: Side-effecting read in group_key_for_epoch mutates state
description: groups_collection.py line 441: group_key_for_epoch calls _live_retired(item, stamp, mutate=now is None). When now is None (the default), this mutates retired_epochs as a side effect. A read-only method should not modify state. This can cause surprising behavior when callers expect a pure read.
close_reason: Already fixed; group_key_for_epoch calls _live_retired without mutate=True; prune only fires in rekey().
